newsitem.title: USA: SeaWorld to expand Florida theme park - report.
newsitem.headline: SeaWorld to expand Florida theme park - report.

text.p: Sea World of Florida has submitted plans to local officials for a major expansion with a thrill ride in an area modeled after the legendary island of Atlantis, the Orlando Sentinel reported on Friday.

The attraction, set to open in 1998 according to plans submitted to county zoning officials, coincides with major expansions at Orlando's other theme parks, Universal Studios Florida and Walt Disney World, the newspaper said.
Each is building a new theme park as well as new nightclubs and restaurants. Industry experts say Sea World has to continue adding attractions to stay competitive.
"They've got to stay in the game with them," the Sentinel quoted Steve Baker, head of Baker Leisure Group in Orlando, as saying. "They've got to stay new and fresh and they're doing that."
Sea World has added eight major attractions and six new shows since 1990, the year after Anheuser-Busch Inc. acquired the park.
Sea World officials refused to comment on the Sentinel report.
